# HSItools

HSItools is an R package to process and visualize hyperspectral core
scanning data.

![HSItools logo](reference/figures/package_logo.png)

HSItools logo

## Installation

You can install the development version of HSItools like so:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")

# pak::pak("mzarowka/HSItools@dev)
```

## Book

A more extensive tutorial is available at:
<https://mzarowka.quarto.pub/hsitools>

## Example

The basic workflow includes running the shiny app to choose analysis
options and visually interact with the core image. After this,
reflectance is calculated and all subsequent operations use reflectance
or its subsets.

``` r

library(HSItools)

# Basic functionality is beeing rewritten now
```

This work is supported by the National Science Centre, Poland, under
research project „Exploring methods of hyperspectral imaging of lake
sediments: proxy development and calibration” (2023/51/D/ST10/00801),
and previously by the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange
(BPN/BEK/2021/1/00133).

![](man/figures%5Clogo-poziom-en.png)

![](reference/figures/nawa_logo.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`hsi_apply_mnf()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_apply_mnf.md)
  : Apply Minimum Noise Fraction transformation to a SpatRaster
- [`hsi_bind_layers()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_bind_layers.md)
  : Bind hyperspectral SpatRasters along the spectral axis
- [`hsi_bind_rows()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_bind_rows.md)
  : Bind hyperspectral SpatRasters along the y-axis
- [`hsi_calc_difference()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_difference.md)
  : Calculate band difference
- [`hsi_calc_mnf()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_mnf.md)
  : Compute Minimum Noise Fraction transform
- [`hsi_calc_ndi()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_ndi.md)
  : Calculate normalized difference index (NDI)
- [`hsi_calc_raba()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_raba.md)
  : Calculate Relative Absorption Band Area (RABA)
- [`hsi_calc_rabd()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_rabd.md)
  : Calculate Relative Absorption Band Depth (RABD)
- [`hsi_calc_ratio()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_ratio.md)
  : Calculate band ratio
- [`hsi_calc_rcv()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_rcv.md)
  : Calculate coefficient of variation of reflectance (Rcv)
- [`hsi_calc_reflectance()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_reflectance.md)
  : Calculate hyperspectral reflectance
- [`hsi_calc_remp()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_remp.md)
  : Calculate lambdaREMP
- [`hsi_calc_rmean()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_rmean.md)
  : Calculate mean reflectance (Rmean)
- [`hsi_calc_rmedian()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_rmedian.md)
  : Calculate median reflectance (Rmedian)
- [`hsi_calc_rsd()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_rsd.md)
  : Calculate standard deviation of reflectance (Rsd)
- [`hsi_calc_stretch()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calc_stretch.md)
  : Stretch selected bands to an RGB preview
- [`hsi_calibration_direct()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calibration_direct.md)
  : Create spatial calibration from known resolution
- [`hsi_calibration_from_dims()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calibration_from_dims.md)
  : Create spatial calibration from image dimensions and physical
  distance
- [`hsi_calibration_from_scale()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_calibration_from_scale.md)
  : Create spatial calibration from a digitized scale reference
- [`hsi_check_gcp()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_check_gcp.md)
  : Assess affine transformation quality from matched GCPs
- [`hsi_coregister()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_coregister.md)
  : Co-register source raster to target raster grid
- [`hsi_create_metadata()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_create_metadata.md)
  : Create structured hyperspectral metadata
- [`hsi_destripe()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_destripe.md)
  : Destripe hyperspectral raster
- [`hsi_drop_crs()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_drop_crs.md)
  : Drop CRS from a SpatRaster or SpatVector
- [`hsi_extract_profile()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_extract_profile.md)
  : Extract value profile along an axis
- [`hsi_extract_spectrum()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_extract_spectrum.md)
  : Extract averaged spectrum from hyperspectral raster
- [`hsi_find_extent()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_find_extent.md)
  : Find a fixed-width extent from reference points
- [`hsi_mask()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_mask.md)
  : Mask hyperspectral raster
- [`hsi_match_gcp()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_match_gcp.md)
  : Match ground control points between two SpatVectors
- [`hsi_pixels_to_units()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_pixels_to_units.md)
  : Convert pixel coordinates to physical units
- [`hsi_plot_composite()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_plot_composite.md)
  : Composite hyperspectral indices plots Can composite line profiles
  and SpatRasters
- [`hsi_plot_profile()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_plot_profile.md)
  : Plot a depth profile
- [`hsi_plot_raster()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_plot_raster.md)
  : Plot a single-layer SpatRaster
- [`hsi_plot_raster_rgb()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_plot_raster_rgb.md)
  : Plot a three-layer pseudoRGB SpatRaster
- [`hsi_plot_spectrum()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_plot_spectrum.md)
  : Plot a reflectance spectrum
- [`hsi_read_metadata()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_read_metadata.md)
  : Read hsi_metadata from file
- [`hsi_remove_continuum()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_remove_continuum.md)
  : Remove continuum from hyperspectral data
- [`hsi_set_extent()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_set_extent.md)
  : Set raster extent to physical units
- [`hsi_smooth_median()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_smooth_median.md)
  : Focal raster smooth with a median
- [`hsi_smooth_savgol()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_smooth_savgol.md)
  : Spectral raster smooth with a Savitzky-Golay filter
- [`hsi_subset()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_subset.md)
  : Subset SpatRaster by wavelength
- [`hsi_subset_range()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_subset_range.md)
  : Subset SpatRaster by wavelength range
- [`hsi_tiled()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_tiled.md)
  : Process a SpatRaster in parallel tiles
- [`hsi_write_metadata()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_write_metadata.md)
  : Write hsi_metadata to file
- [`hsi_write_scaled()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/hsi_write_scaled.md)
  : Write HSI reflectance raster as a scaled integer or float GeoTIFF
- [`spectral_indices`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/spectral_indices.md)
  : Preset spectral indices definitions
- [`wavelength_position()`](https://mzarowka.github.io/HSItools/dev/reference/wavelength_position.md)
  : Find position of selected wavelengths
